text: Come near, you nations, and listen; pay attention, you peoples! Let the earth hear, and all that is in it, the world, and all that comes out of it!
his wrath is upon all their armies. He will totally destroy them, he will give them over to slaughter.
their dead bodies will send up a stench; the mountains will be soaked with their blood.
and the sky rolled up like a scroll; all the starry host will fall like withered leaves from the vine, like shriveled figs from the fig tree.
